project_definition.monkey_head_project: The Monkey-Head-Project is the long-running umbrella project through which Huey is designed, built, documented, tested, and evolved.
project_definition.huey: Huey is the proposed locally operated embodied governed collective identity arising from separable citizens, districts, offices, HIMS, the Rock, the Walnut, the Pulse and physical interfaces; the currently developed V4 body does not imply a completed polity.
project_definition.philosophy: Breathing new life into old tech
operating_principles: Prefer useful reuse and retrofit over unnecessary replacement.
Keep the first Huey node capable of meaningful standalone local operation.
Treat the physical Body, local compute, cognition framework, memory, governance, and internal communication system as parts of one evolving architecture.
Use open/local models where practical so core cognition can operate without mandatory dependence on external cloud services.
Preserve modular boundaries so parts can be repaired, replaced, expanded, bifurcated, or reconfigured without redefining the whole project.
Distinct citizens and institutions must remain authenticated and bounded, even when they share model weights.
Demonstrations must separate model-output identity from audited constitutional and embodied agency.
Physical safety interlocks act outside model/governance latency.
project_definition.labtech_boundary: LabTech is external support technology used around Huey; it is not Huey's operational identity, Body, Brain, Farm, or internal cognition.

historical_lineage.age_statement: The Monkey-Head-Project has existed in one form or another for at least ten years.
historical_lineage.formative_period: The project began as a modular robotics and distributed-computing concept before the names Huey and Monkey-Head-Project were fully established. Early work emphasized reusable parts, expandable physical shells, and the ability to change the system quickly.
historical_lineage.llm_acceleration: The public arrival of GPT-3.5-era ChatGPT was a major inflection point because it demonstrated a practical language-model cognition layer that could serve as the encapsulated reasoning component the physical project had been missing.

single_board_computing_lineage.raspberry_pi: Raspberry Pi systems, especially the Raspberry Pi 3/3B+ and to a lesser extent the Pi 4, were formative tools for learning Linux, single-board computing, and distributed-system thinking.
single_board_computing_lineage.current_role: Raspberry Pi is historical technical lineage, not a required current Huey dependency.
single_board_computing_lineage.microcontroller_direction: Arduino-class boards are the present preferred intermediary between high-level compute and low-level sensors, buttons, actuators, and animatronics.

shell_generations.V1: The first long-running physical shell was a rapidly modifiable wooden enclosure built from salvaged hardwood from an older dresser. Wood was intentionally used because it could be drilled, cut, filled, changed, and rebuilt quickly while the architecture was still fluid.
shell_generations.V2: V2 became one of the project's most photographed and visually recognizable stages. Much legacy project imagery still originates from this era.
shell_generations.V3: V3 was a consolidation phase that reduced the embodiment toward essential structural elements and helped establish the metal-frame direction carried into V4.
shell_generations.V4: V4 is a synthesis rather than a clean replacement: it recombines surviving/reworked V2 and V3 elements with additional salvaged materials into the current rolling wooden base, modified Thermaltake Mozart compute midsection, and hybrid WowWee animatronic head.

animatronic_head_lineage.first_unit: The first unit had its rubber removed, was stripped toward the essential plastic/mechanical structure, painted metallic silver, and served through V1, V2, and V3. Its silver appearance became a major part of the project's visual identity.

animatronic_head_lineage.v4_direction: Build one hybrid head using the best surviving plastic, mechanical, and animatronic parts from both units.

node_first_architecture.principle: A Huey node is a physically individual AI unit with integrated local compute, cognition, body functions, memory, and governance.
node_first_architecture.standalone_operation: Standalone local operation is central. The first physical Huey should be valid without requiring a network of separate Huey robots.
node_first_architecture.internal_collective: One Huey machine can contain four logically independent districts and 256 citizen identities without requiring 256 concurrently running LLM instances; the collective is not yet deployed.
node_first_architecture.collective_membership: Long-term architecture may allow multiple Huey nodes to coordinate or share infrastructure, but that is not required for the first node to be valid.

identity_model.principle: Huey is an attributed collective result, not identical to a model, one president/justice, a pebble, the shell or the human maintainer. Continuity through replacement/bifurcation is a research question requiring traceable processes and tests.
identity_model.walnut_metaphor: The local LLM is the 'walnut': an encapsulated language/reasoning engine expected to do what large language models do best while remaining bounded by Huey's Constitution, memory, job structure, sandboxes, permissions, and checks and balances.
identity_model.collective_identity: Proposed internal relationship among bounded pebbles, four districts, Senate, President, Court, HIMS messaging, Rock records, Walnut model(s), timed Pulse, Brain/Body/Farm hardware, and human-facing interfaces. Does not demonstrate consciousness.
identity_model.focal_embodiment: A historical explanatory analogy compares the architecture to a collective with a focal physical aperture: the visible embodiment can represent the whole without being the whole by itself.

three_part_architecture.decision: Organize the current system around Huey Brain, Huey Body, and Huey Farm while recognizing that identity emerges across the governed collective rather than from one unrestricted component.

presidency.priority_accountability: Each rejected priority attempt gets review of asserted urgency; three consecutive failed priority initiatives may trigger loss-of-confidence inquiry, not automatic removal.
presidency.veto: One veto of ordinary law; may be overridden by two-thirds of at least three districts. No presidential priority or privileged veto of constitutional amendments.
presidency.directives: Narrow implementation directives with specified scope and expiry/renewal, review at the next 8-minute Pulse as default; no automatic expiration at eight minutes.
presidency.temporary_protection: No involuntary exact bifurcation while in office absent lawful succession first.
presidency.caretaker: Separately elected at each presidential election, dormant until both President and Vice President are unavailable. Narrow existing-duty execution for at most 30 calendar days, expedited election, no veto/amendments/justice appointments/major Walnut replacement/extension by admin. presidency.lineage_term_continuity: Objective presidential service and unexpired cooldowns carry to both exact descendants; office and personal guilt do not automatically transfer.

glossary.Monkey-Head-Project: Umbrella project through which Huey is built, documented, and evolved.
glossary.Huey: The attributed identity of the proposed embodied constitutional collective, not its model, shell or one office.
glossary.Walnut: Replaceable model-serving/inference resource without unilateral civic authority.
glossary.Pebble: Unique bounded AI citizen in proposed Huey republic with distinct active identity, vault, lawful jobs and one valid vote per eligible question; not one model process each.
glossary.District: Founding internal jurisdiction of 64 citizens, four political vote blocks; district population may grow through verified exact bifurcation while political representation changes only through constitutional amendment.
glossary.Atom: Historical/provisional label for the first four district grouping, not a settled requirement.
glossary.Bifurcation: Authenticated lineage event with separate exact (one retired parent, two active descendants) and augmented (approved distinct new citizen without automatic inherited memory) modes. Exact incapacity bifurcation must be next authorized cycle subject to safety.
glossary.HIMS: Huey Internal Messaging System: authenticated protected communication and mediated authorization. Transport is not automatic execution authority.
glossary.Founding Father: 64-configuration bootstrap author and preparer of provisional republic; post-ratification Tier One advisory plus narrowly qualified safety-state request, not supreme arbiter or election tie-breaker.
glossary.LabTech: External development, maintenance and diagnostic machines; not a constituent citizen or office of Huey.
glossary.Rock: Durable shared/collective record store with restricted reads and authorization-mediated writes; not collective cognition.
glossary.Exact Bifurcation: Source retires and two equal descendants inherit access to sealed read-only ancestral history; new identity, keys and separate future memory.
glossary.Augmented Bifurcation: Source remains active and one new citizen inherits selected prompt/traits, with new identity and no automatic inherited private memory.
glossary.Pulse: Proposed unbenchmarked four-minute unified plus four-minute diversified operating phases; not four-month election term and not validated deadline.
glossary.Electoral Term: Four months between ordinary presidential elections, independently of the eight-minute operational Pulse.
glossary.Senate: Proposed branch aggregating lawful citizen/district votes. Ordinary law needs 3/4 certifiable district approval blocks with majority Y>N of substantive ballots after 80% P and two-thirds S floors.
glossary.President: Proposed directly elected, restricted executive with four-month term, ranked election, term cooldowns, stage-verified removal; distinct separately elected emergency caretaker for double vacancy.
glossary.Vice President: Runner-up in direct presidential election, standby successor with no independent routine executive power.
glossary.Supreme Court: Four founding district judicial seats, three lawful concurring votes for EVERY binding judgment; independent conflict screening and home-district standby.
glossary.Constitution: RC1.3 Third-Generation unratified proposal with Preamble/C01–C10/Closing and nine implementing Schedules, not the archived Federation Constitution.
glossary.Human Counterpart: External human project author/service authority who may originate Walnut replacement proposals, provision independent founding certifier and hold explicitly bounded recovery/refounding roles; internal votes not puppeted.
glossary.Local-First: Core reasoning, state and governance intended to remain local; optional external development APIs are explicitly disclosed and separate.
glossary.Valid Participation P: YES+NO+authenticated ABSTAIN; requires ceil(4E/5) for district certification.
glossary.Substantive Ballots S: YES+NO only; requires ceil(2E/3); deliberate abstention can prevent local certification without implying disability.
glossary.Constitutional Block Vote: One separately certified district decision; ordinary 3/4 blocks with Yes greater than No after both floors; unavailable block cannot be inferred.
glossary.Tier Two: Qualified Founder-requested protected hibernation for extraordinary real integrity/safety conditions, latched recovery by original human or exactly one separately credentialed human successor.
glossary.Human Recovery Successor: One predetermined separately credentialed human at a time, restricted to approved restoration; no automatic Walnut-selection, election or refounding right.
glossary.Emergency Caretaker: Separately pre-elected citizen activated on verified President/VP double vacancy, at most 30 calendar days with restricted existing-duty powers and expedited election.
glossary.Refounding: Distinct from restoration: surviving institutions require 3 district special blocks, 3 judicial concurrences, separate human authorization and fresh ratification; total destruction permits honestly NEW founding only.
glossary.High-Legitimacy, Lower-Availability: Design choice that withholds new authority when authentically required ballots/seats are absent rather than weakening voting, quorum or safety controls.
glossary.Founding Invalid-Epoch Escalation: Predeclared human/verifier review on repeated failed ballot epochs/time without certification; candidate 3 invalid epochs/72h not approved until prospective authorization; never ratification.
